spacr.qt.mask_engine.VolumeMaskSession:
Edit native spatial labels using the same boundary as the 3-D gate view.

Coordinates are physical X/Y/Z distances from the image's outer origin;
voxel centres lie at ``(index + 0.5) * spacing``. Arrays retain their
declared spatial axis order, source dtype and existing object identities.
At most 16,777,216 voxels and 256 MiB of source intensities are accepted;
larger fields are refused explicitly. Sparse undo deltas have a combined
64 MiB budget rather than retaining a volume for every edit.

:param image: finite real numeric three-dimensional source intensities.
:param mask: nonnegative integer labels of exactly the source shape.
:param axes: a permutation of the three spatial axes ``XYZ``.
:param spacing: positive finite distances in that same array axis order.
:param unit: the physical distance unit, or ``pixel`` when unspecified.
Validate one spatial image and own its mutable label array.

:param image: finite real numeric source intensities.
:param mask: nonnegative integer object labels matching the image.
:param axes: spatial storage-axis order, a permutation of XYZ.
:param spacing: three positive finite distances in storage order.
:param unit: the common distance unit.
spacr.qt.mask_engine.VolumeMaskSession.a:
Commit one validated shared boundary and its exact mask voxels.

Other object IDs are protected. Invalid motion, collisions or a delta
exceeding the history budget leave arrays, geometry and history intact.

:param label: positive ID representable by the current mask dtype.
:param gate: shared ``EditableVolumeGate`` with physical X/Y/Z columns.
:returns: number of changed voxels.
spacr.qt.mask_engine.VolumeMaskSession.g:
Return saved geometry or an exact closed voxel-boundary mesh.

Corner-touching, disconnected or excessively detailed labels that
cannot satisfy the shared mesh's bounds/topology are refused rather
than replaced by a bounding box. Merely previewing this mesh does not
change voxels, history or saved geometry.

:param label: an existing positive object identifier.
:returns: a validated shared editable volume in physical coordinates.
spacr.qt.mask_engine.VolumeMaskSession.l: The exact physical outer image bounds in X/Y/Z order.
spacr.qt.mask_engine.VolumeMaskSession.n: Return the first unused positive ID without renumbering any object.
spacr.qt.mask_engine.VolumeMaskSession.r: Reapply the most recently undone voxel delta and geometry.
spacr.qt.mask_engine.VolumeMaskSession.u: Restore the preceding sparse voxel delta and immutable geometry.
spacr.qt.mask_engine.VolumeMaskSession.x: Voxel distances in physical X/Y/Z order, independent of storage.
spacr.qt.mask_engine.load_volume_image_a:
Open an explicitly declared grayscale spatial TIFF for native 3-D editing.

Exactly three spatial axes are supported, in any order. Time, channel,
colour and inferred page axes are refused. ``voxel_spacing`` metadata is
read in storage-axis order. OME physical sizes are converted to micrometres;
ImageJ spacing and XY resolution are retained. Absent physical metadata
means pixel coordinates.
Labels retain dtype and identity. A saved geometry sidecar is bound to
the exact source file and mask pixels and is refused when stale.

:param folder: source image directory.
:param filename: spatial TIFF image filename.
:param masks_dir: optional existing sibling mask directory.
:returns: a ``VolumeMaskSession`` owning the labels and source metadata.
spacr.qt.mask_engine.save_volume_mask:
Write native labels and their source-bound shared boundary sidecar.

Both artifacts are prepared before replacing either destination. A failed
second replacement restores the previous pair. Source/output identities
are rechecked after staging. Two filenames cannot form a fully atomic
transaction against an uncooperative concurrent writer; interrupted or
mismatched publications are refused by the source/mask-bound sidecar on
loading. Source axes, spacing, label dtype and IDs are preserved.

:param session: a volume session loaded through the existing mask paths.
:returns: the canonical TIFF mask path.
spacr.qt.screens.make_masks.MakeMasksScr:
Open a native spatial TIFF in the shared 3-D anchor editor.

The existing 2-D image, mask tools and YOLO annotations stay separate.
Time/channel/RGB TIFFs are refused rather than interpreted as depth.

:param path: optional spatial TIFF path; otherwise opens a file picker.
:returns: the native volume dialog, or None on cancellation/refusal.
Pick the nearest actual boundary triangle after camera rotation.

:param event: a Matplotlib pointer event in the current volume axes.
:returns: ``(gate name, surface identifier)`` or ``None``.
spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec.EditableVolum:
A closed editable piecewise-linear volume used by both drawing and gating.

:param name: unique gate name used by the gating hierarchy.
:param parent: optional parent gate restricting this volume's membership.
:param x_column: measurement along the first data axis.
:param y_column: measurement along the second data axis.
:param z_column: measurement along the third data axis.
:param vertices: finite distinct three-dimensional boundary coordinates.
:param faces: consistently oriented triangles indexing shared vertices.
:param surface_groups: selectable surface identifier for each triangle;
    triangles in one group move together. Empty assigns one group per triangle.
Freeze and validate every coordinate, boundary connection and surface.

Sample every surface and edge with uniformly spaced barycentric anchors.

Density changes only visible editing handles, never scientific geometry.
Shared edges and vertices expose one canonical handle.

:param density: subdivisions per triangle edge, 1 to 8.
:returns: unique anchors in deterministic surface order.
Return the first two components of the vertex centroid for flat tools.
The measurement columns matching every vertex coordinate.
Describe the measurements and the actual editable boundary size.

Make a shared boundary for a box, cylinder, prism, ellipsoid or view gate.

Curved surfaces become an explicitly piecewise-linear boundary when
edited; the original analytic gate remains unchanged until commit.

:param gate: the existing three-dimensional gate and its hierarchy.
:param limits: finite axis bounds used only for an unbounded original
    side or a view gate's finite depth, in ``gate.columns`` order.
    Omitting required bounds is refused. A view gate is bounded at the
    nearest and farthest projected depths of these limits when edited.
:param segments: circumference samples for curved shapes, 8 to 128.
:param depth_steps: evenly spaced axial intervals, 1 to 16.
:returns: the closed volume with shared selectable surfaces.
Resolve one explicit bound without inventing an unseen extent.

Test measured points against this same closed mesh using signed solid angles.

Boundary points are included. Nonfinite measurements are excluded. Work
is bounded to 4096 points per triangle without allocating a voxel volume.

:param frame: measurements containing all three gate columns.
:returns: one boolean per row in the original order.

Move selected surfaces and their shared anchors once, maintaining connectivity.

:param groups: existing surface identifiers; repetitions have no effect.
:param delta: displacement in the three measurement dimensions.

Displace each selected shared vertex once and validate the new boundary.

:param indices: vertex indices; repeated indices are deduplicated.
:param delta: displacement along each of the three data axes.
:raises GateError: on invalid indices, nonfinite motion or invalid geometry.

Scale all three dimensions about the centroid or a supplied flat anchor.

:param factor: positive finite scale factor.
:param about: optional first/second-axis centre; depth uses its centroid.
Serialize the exact mesh, grouped surfaces and gate hierarchy.

Move the first two axes while preserving depth and all shared vertices.

:param dx: first-axis displacement in measurement units.
:param dy: second-axis displacement in measurement units.

Move an existing vertex or insert and move an edge/surface anchor.

Inserting an edge anchor splits every incident triangle together, so no
crack appears between surfaces. Repeated editing never changes columns.

:param role: canonical role returned by :meth:`anchors`.
:param point: target coordinate in the three measurement dimensions.
:raises GateError: invalid roles, nonfinite targets or invalid deformations.
